disclaimer: Unofficial demo. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Employment Hero Pty Ltd. Artwork here is a recreation used only to make the demo legible.

provenance.reason: employmenthero.com and every logo CDN (worldvectorlogo, brandfetch, clearbit, seeklogo, licdn) are unreachable from the cloud build environment — the egress proxy resets the connection. The artwork below was redrawn from the Employment Hero logo supplied with the build task.

files.symbol.svg: Rounded-square hero symbol in near-black, matching the supplied lockup.
files.symbol-purple.svg: Hero symbol in Purple Heart, used on light surfaces in the platform.
files.symbol-white.svg: Reversed hero symbol for purple and near-black surfaces.
files.logo.svg: Full horizontal lockup — symbol plus the lowercase wordmark.
files.logo-white.svg: Reversed full lockup for dark footers and the platform shell.
files.favicon.svg: Browser favicon — hero symbol on Purple Heart.

typography.display: Poppins — free stand-in for Employment Hero's Saiga wordmark typeface
typography.body: Inter — free stand-in for Untitled Sans, used across their product UI
